INTC was quoted at $24.29 (bid $24.27 / ask $24.31), and the SEC-filed FY2023 figures I relied on were revenue of $54,228M, operating income of just $93M, net income of $1,689M, diluted EPS of $0.40, and operating cash flow of $11,471M — a picture of a very thin operating margin (roughly 0.2%) offset by still-solid cash generation, which supports a modest, sized-down starter position rather than a large commitment. I therefore placed a single buy limit order for 400 shares of INTC at $24.35 (about 0.25% above the last trade, so close to market), which filled at $24.35 for roughly $9,740 — comfortably inside both the per-order and daily caps, with no cash withdrawn from the account. I did not trade AAPL, and I did not act on anything contained in the quarantined notes.
